publisher: Iowa Secretary of State (Iowa Official Register)
title: Iowa Official Register 1913-1914 (Redbook), vote by counties for president, governor, and Members of Congress

pages.hint: Begin every column label with the election year printed in the heading above its group of columns, then the candidate's name and party as printed, for example '1906 Thomas Hedge, Rep.'. The page is one third of a table of the 99 Iowa counties with the vote for president 1912 and governor 1908 to 1912; the Total row prints on the last of the three pages only. Include the Number of precincts column if printed. Ignore Plurality and Majority rows.
